heading: Today
text: Some low clouds and patches of valley fog, then partly to mostly sunny.  Highs in the 70s to around 80.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Tonight
text: Fair early, then some periods of clouds overnight, tending to clear toward morning.  Some patches of river valley fog east.  Lows in the 50s, near 50 in the cool spots east, to some low 60s in the broader valleys west.  Winds light and variable, becoming south near 10 mph from the Green Mountains west.

heading: Thursday
text: Patchy fog thinning for some sun.  Building clouds leading to scattered showers or thunderstorms in NY and the St. Lawrence Valley midday, spreading east in the afternoon, reaching NH late in the day.  Warmer.  Highs in the upper 70s to low 80s.  South winds near 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph east of the Green Mountains, and 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph from the Green Mountains west.
